title: Read the start years, and refuse what is not a schedule
heading: The Schedule Is Read Off the Variables That Are 1
cases: every project is reported, with its start year if funded and None if not
a deferral is the number of years a funded project starts after its earliest allowed year
a value a tolerance away from 0 or 1 is read as that whole number
a value that is neither near 0 nor near 1 is refused rather than rounded
a project with two start variables at 1 is refused rather than given either year
a project that starts in its earliest year is not reported as deferred
